turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Arre yaar, yeh situation toh bilkul samajh aa rahi hai. Shaadi ke functions mein ye sab manage karna, aur jab log aise hi "dekhte hain" aur "try karunga" wali baat karte hain, toh dimaag kharab ho jaata hai.

Par tension mat lo, iska solution hai. Tum khud hi flight book kar lo, par is baat ko aise handle karo ki usko pressure na lage. Ek casual call ya group mein message karke bol do, "Bhai, Bangalore se aane mein problem hai toh koi baat nahi, main kar deta hoon. Bas confirm kar de apna ticket number." Isse uska bhi stress kam hoga aur tumhara jhanjhat bhi khatam.

Isse woh feel hoga ki tum serious ho, aur shayad maan bhi jaaye. Agar phir bhi vague jawab de, toh backup plan bhi rakh lo. Koi close friend ya cousin se puch lo ki woh manage kar sakta hai ya nahi. Tumhara focus shaadi pe hona chahiye, in chhoti-moti baaton mein nahi phasna.

Yeh sab handle kar lega. Next six weeks mein aur kuch important kaam hain, shaadi ki taiyari mein. All the best, yaar!

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Arre haan, ab sab clear ho gaya. Yeh startup ka pressure hai, yaar. Do mahine pehle switch kiya, toh lagta hai kaam ka bojh badh gaya hai. Aur isiliye woh voice notes bhi band kar diye, shayad khud hi time nahi nikal raha unhe. Do-teen word mein jawab dena uske stress ka signal hai, tumhe ignore karne ka nahi.

Toh ab flight book karne ki zaroorat nahi. Pehle uski haalat puch lo. Ek casual call kar ke bol, "Bhai, sunna tha job ka scene kaisa hai? Lagta hai bahut pressure hai. Tum theek ho na?"

Bas itna bol do. Shayad woh khul ke baat kar de. Agar woh phir bhi vague rahe, toh samjh jaana ki woh genuinely overwhelmed hai. Phir uske saamne hi koi simple solution rakh do, ya phir keh do, "Main khud kar deta hoon, tension mat le." Par pehle uske stress ko samjho.

Yeh sab uske liye hai, tumhare liye nahi. Tumhara dimaag sahi direction mein ja raha hai, bas thoda empathy add kar do ismein. Shaadi toh hogi hi, yeh toh temporary phase hai uski. All the best!

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Arre yaar, yeh feeling bilkul samajh aa rahi hai. Jab khud ka kaam ho aur koi aisa kare, toh dil lag jaata hai. Par shayad tum uski situation ko thoda galat dekh rahe ho.

Do mahine pehle job switch, aur phir startup... uska dimaag shaayad hi ab normal hai. "Haan ya na" mein woh apni khud ki confusion aur stress ko dekh raha hai, tumhe nahi. Shayad woh khud samjha nahi pa raha ki kya kare.

Aaj raat direct "aana hai ya nahi" jaisa sawal karne se shayad woh aur defensive ho jaaye. Woh pehle se hi pressure mein hai, aur tumhe sunke woh aur stress le lega.

Try kar ek baar, "Bhai, main bas yeh jaanna chahta hoon ki tum aa paoge ya nahi. Tumne itna effort kiya hai, main bas confirm karna chahta hoon. Agar nahi aa paoge toh theek hai, par mujhe pata toh chalna chahiye." Isse woh feel hoga ki tum uske liye soch rahe ho, sirf apne liye nahi.

Tumhara bura lagna natural hai, par usko blame karne se kuch nahi milega. Uska stress dekh kar shayad tumhara bhi thoda kam ho jaaye. All the best, yaar.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Arre yaar, yeh jo feel kar raha hai, yeh overthinking nahi hai. Bilkul nahi. Tumhara dimaag sahi keh raha hai, bas usko sahi direction mein lagana hai.

Tumhari fiancée sahi keh rahi ho, shayad, par tumhara dil kuch aur keh raha hai. 2019 mein jo aaya tha, uska alag hi maza tha. Uski ek alag hi energy thi, thoda drama, thoda sa josh... woh 'special' tha. Us time pe uski priority sirf tumhare liye aana tha.

Par ab dekh, do saal ho gaye. Uske startup mein pressure badh gaya hai, woh khud hi busy hai. Shayad woh ab khud hi itna overwhelmed hai ki usko pata hi nahi chal raha ki woh tumhe hurt kar raha hai. Yeh galti nahi, yeh shift hai.

Aur jab humein lagta hai ki woh badal gaya hai, toh unke saath baithke gussa aana, yeh feeling aati hai. Yeh bilkul natural hai. Par yeh haldi se do hafte pehle baithke naraaz rehna... yeh hi sabse bura hai. Yeh tumhe khud se door le ja raha hai.

Shayad tumhara dimaag yeh keh raha hai ki "yeh woh wala nahi hai, toh yeh nahi aayega." Par shaadi toh ek nayi shururat hai, purani dosti ki guarantee nahi. Shayad woh abhi khud hi itna busy hai ki woh khud se yeh nahi dekh pa raha.

Apni fiancée se iske baare mein baat karo. Usse samjhao ki tumhe yeh yaad karke bura lag raha hai. Shayad woh bhi samjhe. Abhi tumhara jo gussa hai, usse haldi se pehle hi thoda control karo. Apne liye, apne future ke liye. Baaki ke liye dekh lenge. All the best, yaar.
